system.notes:
SCADA control host for Shiawase's Cascades nuclear generating station. Controls reactor coolant systems, turbine load balancing, and emergency shutdown protocols. Physical hardline access only — remote wireless connections are rejected at the SAN. GOD watches this host directly.

Notable data: Reactor state data, plant schematics, physical security patrol schedules, coolant override codes. Triggering a meltdown is possible from here — which is exactly why this host is Black tier and why no one sane runs it alone.

nodes.name: System Access Node
nodes.description: Air-gapped gateway. The SAN rejects all wireless handshake protocols at the hardware level — Faraday shielding covers the entire compound. The only valid connections originate from the hardlined control room consoles. Any external probe of this SAN is logged and treated as a physical security threat.

nodes.name: I/O Port — Reactor Control Room
nodes.description: Hardlined consoles in the primary reactor control room — the only legitimate entry to the network. Physical access requires: outer perimeter badge entry at a guarded gatehouse, inner airlock biometric scan, dual-key hardware token challenge, and Shiawase Nuclear Division clearance level 5. Armed security is stationed directly adjacent. Engineers and security are present 24/7.

nodes.name: Sub-Processing Unit
nodes.description: Central routing hub. All telemetry from the four reactor cores flows here continuously: coolant temperatures, rod positions, containment integrity, turbine load curves. IC patrol is constant. There is no idle time on this node, no quiet moment in which to move unnoticed.

nodes.name: Slave Node — Reactor SCADA
nodes.description: Direct control interface for all four reactor units: coolant flow regulation, control rod positioning, containment pressure, primary loop integrity checks, and emergency SCRAM triggers. A hostile actor with access here can initiate meltdown within minutes. The barrier rating reflects exactly how seriously Shiawase treats this risk.

nodes.name: Data Store — Operational Records
nodes.description: Real-time and archived reactor telemetry, maintenance logs, safety system test results, fuel cycle records, and waste processing schedules. Buried within: the override sequences for every safety interlock in the complex. In the wrong hands this is a technical manual for catastrophic failure across four reactor cores.

nodes.name: Data Store — Classified Research
nodes.description: Shiawase Nuclear Division black-budget R&D: next-generation compact reactor designs, classified fuel reprocessing techniques, and programmes the public does not know exist. Corporate intelligence value is measured in hundreds of millions. Nation-states have attempted to steal this data. Most of the attempts are still officially classified.

nodes.name: Central Processing Unit
nodes.description: The administrative brain of the Cascades network. Manages IC deployment, credential validation, safety interlock master overrides, and emergency shutdown authority for all four reactors. Breaching the CPU places four nuclear reactors under hostile control. Shiawase has authorised lethal Matrix countermeasures at this node without exception or review.

ioPorts.name: Primary Reactor Control Room Consoles
ioPorts.physicalLocation: Reactor Building Alpha, Control Room Level 2. Six hardlined engineering consoles — no wireless access anywhere in the compound. Reaching this jackpoint requires breaching the outer perimeter gatehouse (armed guards, vehicle barriers), clearing the inner airlock biometric checkpoint, and presenting a valid dual-key hardware token and Shiawase Nuclear clearance level 5 credential. Armed security is stationed at the console bank at all times. The compound exterior is under continuous patrol with helicopter support.

triggerSteps.label: TS 1
triggerSteps.description: Alert (Passive) and Encryption (Passive) activate simultaneously — no grace period. Shiawase's 24/7 nuclear Matrix security team receives notification within 15 seconds. All data streams in the host are encrypted mid-transit from this moment. The duty sysop escalates to the on-call security commander immediately.

triggerSteps.label: TS 2
triggerSteps.description: Authenticator launches at SAN. All active sessions are re-challenged with hardware token verification — a rolling cryptographic challenge that rotates every 30 seconds. Standard Decrypt programs cannot bypass this. Shiawase Nuclear credentials are issued on proprietary hardware and are not reproducible with off-the-shelf tools.

triggerSteps.label: TS 3
triggerSteps.description: Tracker deploys from SPU, feeding live telemetry directly to the Shiawase Nuclear Security Operations Centre. Physical security teams begin systematic sweep of all I/O jackpoint locations. The reactor control room is being locked down: engineers evacuating, armed security moving to positions. Reactor systems shifted to monitor-only mode pending security clearance.

triggerSteps.label: TS 4
triggerSteps.description: Blaster launches — Overload attack, Moderate damage. Nuclear infrastructure is federally classified as critical national infrastructure. Shiawase is legally authorised and contractually required to deploy lethal countermeasures at this tier. The duty officer has already authorised aggressive response. This is not a warning shot.

triggerSteps.label: TS 5
triggerSteps.description: Crippler targets all active programs in sequence: attack and exploit programs first, then utilities. Each pass reduces one program's effective rating by 1. The decker's toolbox is being systematically disassembled. At System Rating 10, Crippler tests resolve at TN 10 — the IC barely breaks a sweat.

triggerSteps.label: TS 6
triggerSteps.description: Hydra deploys — one coordinated attack instance per node the decker has accessed. Moving to any node the decker has touched means walking into another attack vector. There is no safe ground left. Each Hydra head attacks at Power 10; the decker is fighting on as many fronts as nodes they have visited.

triggerSteps.label: TS 7
triggerSteps.description: Killer deploys from CPU. Physical damage in VR-Hot. SN reactor controls locked to emergency read-only mode — no commands can be issued to reactor systems while Killer is active. Shiawase prioritises asset denial over operational continuity at this step. SCRAM procedures being evaluated by the control room team.

triggerSteps.label: TS 8
triggerSteps.description: Ripper deploys. Black IC — lethal in VR-Hot. Every attack delivers Physical damage at Power = System Rating. Ripper does not release pursuit until the persona is crashed or destroyed. DS-A and DS-B both sealed with secondary encryption keyed to off-site biometrics — inaccessible without keys held by senior Shiawase Nuclear executives. Two corporate response aircraft are already airborne. Federal emergency services notified under critical infrastructure protocol.

triggerSteps.label: TS 9
triggerSteps.description: Convergence. Full network lockdown. SN initiates automatic controlled SCRAM — all four reactors entering emergency shutdown. GOD trace complete. Shiawase Nuclear Security, UCAS Federal Emergency Response, and Lone Star Crisis Response are all inbound simultaneously. The compound is in full lockdown. This intrusion will be the lead item on every news channel in Seattle within the hour. The runners have minutes, at most.
